title: Kelly, U.S. Army Special Forces 1961–1971 (CIDG camp status tables)
citation: Kelly, Francis J., Colonel. U.S. Army Special Forces 1961–1971. Vietnam Studies, Department of the Army, Washington D.C., 1973. Chapter on the CIDG program July 1963–May 1965, Tables 2–4: 'Status Report, U.S. Special Forces CIDG Camps, October 1964' lists camp 'Nui Ba Den' with 1 U.S. officer, 5 enlisted, 175 strike-force irregulars.
notes: The official Army historical monograph. Documents a half-size Special Forces element at a CIDG camp at Núi Bà Đen itself in October 1964 — squarely inside Larry's tour and matching his account of a skeleton SF presence on the mountain.
